tool_schemas.name: run_code
tool_schemas.description: Authenticates the caller by API key and executes the provided request payload in a sandbox: it will run in the specified sandbox_id or provision a new sandbox using the requested runtime/region/image/resources/ttl, and returns the execution result along with the sandbox identifier and a persisted execution event for debugging/auditing; if idempotency_key is provided, retries return the original result without creating a duplicate execution. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when api_key/sandbox_id do not match the required formats, resource/ttl fields are non-positive, unknown fields are sent, or sandbox creation fields are missing/invalid when sandbox_id is omitted; raises UNAUTHORIZED when the api_key is invalid or revoked and FORBIDDEN when the key lacks permission for the target workspace/region/runtime. Raises NOT_FOUND when sandbox_id does not exist or is not accessible to the authenticated workspace, CONFLICT when attempting to run in a sandbox that is terminated/expired or otherwise not in a runnable state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace exceeds sandbox/concurrency/runtime limits or resource allocations are above the plan.

api_key.description: Caller API key identifier used to authenticate and associate the run with a workspace.

sandbox_id.description: Existing sandbox id to run code in; if omitted a new sandbox is provisioned.

runtime.description: Runtime to provision when creating a new sandbox.

region.description: Region to provision the sandbox in when creating a new sandbox.

image.description: Base image identifier/name to use when creating a new sandbox.

cpu_millicores.description: CPU allocation in millicores for a newly created sandbox.

memory_mb.description: Memory allocation in MB for a newly created sandbox.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds for a newly created sandbox.

request_payload.description: Execution request payload to persist for debugging/auditing (e.g., code, stdin, args, env).

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for safely retrying the same execution without duplicating it.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity derived from the provided API key, including workspace membership, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption; refuses revoked keys or non-active workspaces.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and resolve the owning workspace.

tool_schemas.name: list_sandboxes
tool_schemas.description: Lists sandboxes visible to the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered by status/region/runtime and time range; returns a paginated result set and refuses revoked keys or non-active workspaces.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and scope results to its workspace.

created_after.description: Only return sandboxes created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return sandboxes created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of sandboxes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_sandbox
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single sandbox by id within the authenticated workspace, including its current status and resource configuration; refuses revoked keys, non-active workspaces, or unknown/unauthorized sandbox ids.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and scope access.

tool_schemas.name: terminate_sandbox
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a sandbox to terminated for the authenticated workspace; sets terminated_at and refuses invalid transitions (e.g., already terminated/failed/expired) or access with revoked keys/non-active workspaces.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and scope access.

reason.description: Optional human-readable termination reason for audit/debugging.

tool_schemas.name: list_executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted execution events for the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered by sandbox/status and idempotency_key; returns paginated results and refuses revoked keys or non-active workspaces.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and scope results to its workspace.

created_after.description: Only return executions created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return executions created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_execution
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single execution event by id (including persisted request_payload/response_payload, status, error and usage metrics) within the authenticated workspace; refuses revoked keys, non-active workspaces, or unknown/unauthorized execution ids.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and scope access.

metadata.name: E2B
metadata.description: This backend stores users, API keys, and ephemeral code execution sandboxes created via the E2B API. The primary workflow is authenticating a caller with an API key, provisioning a sandbox, tracking its lifecycle and resource usage, and persisting execution events for debugging, auditing, and quota
